policy: At every positive music-proposer clock read 1.5 s history and at most 300 ms later audio. Use the two fixed Q8 decoders at 1e-15 with the original end tolerance and feature resets. Notify either on an accepted lexical match, or when that same proposal has both lexical and trigger-trained neural confirmation. Keep C161 independent with shared native cooldown. Times measure audio availability, and exclude decoder compute time.
